theme: Casting instants and sorceries from graveyards
reuse: 'You may cast target instant or sorcery card from a graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead' (Halo Forager, Diluvian Primordial, Dire Fleet Daredevil, Mission Briefing, Finale of Promise; Impulsivity in batch 46 has the same sentence — grep it and reuse): game/cast_permission.go, may_cast_keyed.go; exile-and-copy then cast copies (Bloodthirsty Adversary): game/resolution_copy_cast.go, docs 'Copying a card and casting the copy'; 'pay {2}{R} any number of times. When you pay…' reflexive (umbral_collar_zealot.go, game/reflexive.go); delayed mana at next main phase (Plasm Capture): mana_drain.go; Counterpoint casts from your graveyard with an MV cap. Finale of Promise (two targets, copy each twice at X>=10) is the hard one — do it last.

cards.name: Finale of Promise
cards.oracle_text: You may cast up to one target instant card and/or up to one target sorcery card from your graveyard each with mana value X or less without paying their mana costs. If a spell cast this way would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. If X is 10 or more, copy each of those spells twice. You may choose new targets for the copies.

cards.name: Bloodthirsty Adversary
cards.oracle_text:
Haste
When this creature enters, you may pay {2}{R} any number of times. When you pay this cost one or more times, put that many +1/+1 counters on this creature, then exile up to that many target instant and/or sorcery cards with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard and copy them. You may cast any number of the copies without paying their mana costs.

cards.name: Dire Fleet Daredevil
cards.oracle_text:
First strike
When this creature enters, exile target instant or sorcery card from an opponent's graveyard. You may cast it this turn, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.

cards.name: Counterpoint
cards.oracle_text: Counter target spell. You may cast a creature, instant, sorcery, or planeswalker spell from your graveyard with mana value less than or equal to that spell's mana value without paying its mana cost.

cards.name: Halo Forager
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, you may pay {X}. When you do, you may cast target instant or sorcery card with mana value X from a graveyard without paying its mana cost. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.

cards.name: Diluvian Primordial
cards.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, for each opponent, you may cast up to one target instant or sorcery card from that player's graveyard without paying its mana cost. If a spell cast this way would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.

cards.name: Mission Briefing
cards.oracle_text: Surveil 2, then choose an instant or sorcery card in your graveyard. You may cast it this turn. If that spell would be put into your graveyard, exile it instead. (To surveil 2, look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)

cards.name: Plasm Capture
cards.oracle_text: Counter target spell. At the beginning of your next first main phase, add X mana in any combination of colors, where X is that spell's mana value.
